question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Essays must be __concise__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"concise"** means giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **His speech was **concise** and straight to the point.
 
 
 
• **"Lengthy" **refers to something that is long in duration or extent; extended and protracted. (लंबा)
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was so **lengthy **that everyone felt exhausted by the end.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'concise' **is **'lengthy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Total** (कुल): Comprising the whole number or amount.

 
 
• **Example:** The** total **cost of the project was higher than expected.
 
 
 
• **Precise** (सटीक): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example: **Her instructions were clear and **precise.**
 
 
 
• **Excise** (उत्पाद शुल्क): A tax levied on certain goods and commodities produced or sold within a country.
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to increase the** excise** on tobacco products.
